content: B2B dedup best practice: a single strong unique identifier (tax ID/CNPJ) is ideal, but when unavailable, multi-field matching (company name + domain + phone + address fields) is standard, with confidence-scored matching: high-confidence auto-merges, medium-confidence routes to human review, low-confidence stays separate. Company/name-only matching must normalize for abbreviations (Ltda/S.A./Inc), punctuation, case, and whitespace, and should be treated as a first-pass filter, not a final determination, since two distinct companies can have very similar names.
